title: Projectivity over a complete Noetherian base from a projective reduction
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring that is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], let $A\to B$ be of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and let $M$ be a finite $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Assume $M/IM$ is projective over $A/I$ [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. For every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$, regard $M\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ as a $B$-module by the canonical action [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Assume that for every prime $\mathfrak q\subset B$ contracting to $\mathfrak p$ which is an associated prime of this $B$-module (the annihilator of an element, as in [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes]), one has $IB+\mathfrak q\ne B$. Then $M$ is projective over $A$.
